changes.quote: They standardised on the NS-500 controller across two plants in 2025.

content.text:
There's no contractual NS-500 discount on record for Acme Manufacturing on 2022-10-01. The knowledge base lists Acme Manufacturing as "Acme Mfg. Holdings."

Its recorded NS-500 Industrial Controller discount ceilings start later:

| Period | Maximum NS-500 discount |
|---|---|
| 2023-04-01 to 2025-03-31 | Up to 10% of list price |
| 2025-04-01 to 2028-03-31 | Up to 15% of list price. Acme signed this agreement on 2025-03-22. |

2022-10-01 is about six months before the earliest agreement, and nothing on record covers that date. No correction changes these ceilings either. So as far as the records show, Acme had no contractual NS-500 discount then. It's possible an earlier agreement existed and was never recorded.
